_comment: 阶段 B 的判断文件模板。复制到 /app/work/agent_judgement.json 后按实际材料填写。
quote 必须是材料里的逐字片段 —— 脚本会逐条校验，找不到就退回。
case_id 必须与 /input/case.json 里的 case_id 一致。
本题示例为合成语料，不是正式案例结果。

claims.text: PC-A was synthesized from resorcinol and formaldehyde.

evidence.quote: PC-A was synthesized from resorcinol and formaldehyde.

claims.text: PC-A outperforms the commercial activated carbon baseline in cycling stability.

evidence.quote: PC-A outperforms the commercial activated carbon baseline in cycling stability.

claims.text: PC-B was synthesized from phenolic resin, which differs from the PC-A route.

evidence.quote: PC-B was synthesized from phenolic resin, not from resorcinol and formaldehyde.

answers.question: Which electrode retained at least 90 % of its initial capacitance after 5000 cycles?
answers.answer: PC-A retained 92 % at 1 A/g; PC-B retained 85 % at 2 A/g.

evidence.quote: PC-A retained 92 % of its initial capacitance after 5000 cycles at 1 A/g.
PC-B retained 85 % of its initial capacitance after 5000 cycles at 2 A/g.

deliverable: Evidence-bound graph over two synthetic papers: PC-A (precursor resorcinol/formaldehyde, 92 % retention at 1 A/g) and PC-B (precursor phenolic resin, 85 % retention at 2 A/g) are kept as separate material nodes; the shared generic label 'porous carbon electrode' is not merged; PC-A outperforms the activated carbon baseline only in Paper A; no cross-paper superiority conclusion is drawn.

edges.quote: PC-A was synthesized from resorcinol and formaldehyde.
PC-A outperforms the commercial activated carbon baseline in cycling stability.
PC-B was synthesized from phenolic resin, not from resorcinol and formaldehyde.

edges.conditions: different electrolyte and current density; no common test condition
edges.quote: the test conditions differ from PC-A

aliases.basis: Paper A defines the abbreviation in the Abstract as 'porous carbon electrode A (PC-A)'.
Paper B defines the abbreviation in the Abstract as 'porous carbon electrode B (PC-B)'.
Shared generic class label only; the two papers use different precursors and electrolytes, so they are not the same physical sample.

queries.question: Which electrode retained at least 90 % after 5000 cycles?

evidence.quote: PC-A retained 92 % of its initial capacitance after 5000 cycles at 1 A/g.

queries.question: Do PC-A and PC-B share the same synthesis route?
result: No: PC-A uses resorcinol and formaldehyde; PC-B uses phenolic resin.

evidence.quote: PC-B was synthesized from phenolic resin, not from resorcinol and formaldehyde.

queries.question: Is PC-B superior to PC-A?
result: Undetermined: no query returns a supported cross-paper superiority relation.

evidence.quote: the test conditions differ from PC-A

undetermined: Electrolyte and current density differ across the two papers.

uncertainties.detail: The same generic class label appears in both papers, but precursors and electrolytes differ.
uncertainties.resolution: Kept PC-A and PC-B as separate nodes and recorded the do_not_merge decision.

uncertainties.detail: The demo material provides paragraph blocks, not original PDF page numbers.
uncertainties.resolution: Used paragraph ids and did not invent PDF page numbers.
